body.name: Width-two transition arcs
body.construction: Let \(D=(V\setminus X,E^{\mathrm{det}}_{\to}[V\setminus X])\), and let \(a\leadsto_D B\) mean that \(D\) has a possibly length-zero directed path from \(a\) to a vertex of \(B\). The arc set \(A^{\mathrm{proj}}\) contains exactly: \(\sigma\to u_\beta\) for every \(\beta\in\mathcal B\); \(u_\beta\to t\) when \(r_\beta\leadsto_D Y\); \(u_\beta\to u_e\) when \(r_\beta\leadsto_D\{\operatorname{tail}(e)\}\); \(u_e\to t\) when \(\operatorname{head}(e)\leadsto_D Y\); and \(u_e\to u_f\) when \(\operatorname{head}(e)\leadsto_D\{\operatorname{tail}(f)\}\).
